question.problem:
The graph of $y=f(x) +2$ is shown below. Sketch the graph of $y=f(x)?$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14218283/assets/f5404d5fbf52098eaa7161f0219e4df98a3ae9f5b6b7b6b0220089d62abff82d.png)
question.worked_solution:
The graph of $y = f(x) + 2$ can be obtained from the graph of $y = f(x)$ by translating $2$ units *up*. 

So, the graph $y = f(x)$ would be $2$ units *below* the graph of $y = f(x) + 2.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14218283/assets/0ce67d91fd6c15d97e882c785392f001a4f38ed9bedd50d8631b34e4d5543adc.png)
